newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 27.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 27.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

James Hardie Industries Ltd would expand its Texan and Californian fibre cement building product plants, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Friday. "The Herald has learned that Hardie will expand the capacity of its Cleborne plant in Texas from 230 million square feet (MSF) a year to 290 msf (21.4 million square metres to 27 million square metres) by early next year," the newspaper said. Its Fontana plant in California is expected to boost capacity by 144 msf to 180 msf by Christmas.

News Corp Ltd's Fox News unit chose Worldwide Television News (WTN) as global news provider to the Fox News Channel to be launched in the United States on October 7, WTN said on Thursday. WTN, primarily owned by the ABC News unit of The Walt Disney Co, will also provide facilities, news-gathering crews and video for a news-feed service to Fox affiliated television stations, WTN said in a news release.

Orbital Engine Corp Ltd said in New York on Thursday its combustion process engine had been selected to power the planned Indonesian national car. The company said its Orbital Combustion Process Engine had been selected by an Indonesian government group for use in the so-called Maleo project.
Electronics and gaming operator AWA Ltd said late on Thursday it has held talks with international gaming, wagering and entertainment groups to form possible alliances.
